scope: Inspect registered motion reachability in both directions using full boundary states, then select missing transitions in the editor.
checks: Same motion names do not make distinct boundary states connect.
Forward and return distances agree with production connect() at zero, one and 128 intervening sets.
Before transition registration, the six-family registry reports missing connections; after registration, all six connect in both mirrors.
Both mirrored 88-motion registries report all motions reachable in both directions, matching all 174 production bridge distances.
Reachability does not invoke arm planning, register sources or alter the accepted trajectories.

uiImplementation.implemented: Reference selector, bidirectional bridge lengths, missing-only filter and pair selection for existing transition preparation.

crossInvestigation.conclusion: Moving the entire upper-hand band and separating ball planes does not by itself produce a full feasible arm cycle. Candidate failure is not proof of human impossibility.
crossInvestigation.correction: The probe omitted stance initialization. Corrected controls, reruns and production-API verification are recorded in sync-fixed-cross-routes-audit.json. The connection-coverage tests in this report used the production initialization and remain valid.

limitations: Reachability is between the registered starting phases, with at most 128 intervening sets in each direction.
Final composed route length and ball-identity period are checked separately by the existing append/close APIs.
The fixed-cross candidates remain unregistered; the supported initial height definitions remain 54 of 96.
Current UI interactions and rendered appearance remain unverified after the prior browser auto-review rejection.
